commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

source_host=10.100.194.10
destination_dir=/etc/inventory
destination_file=$destination_dir/app.conf
key_file=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync_ed25519

/usr/bin/install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 "$destination_dir"
temporary_file=$(/usr/bin/mktemp "$destination_dir/.app.conf.XXXXXX")
trap '/usr/bin/rm -f "$temporary_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

/usr/bin/ssh -T -i "$key_file" \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o ConnectTimeout=10 \
  root@"$source_host" > "$temporary_file"

/usr/bin/chown root:root "$temporary_file"
/usr/bin/chmod 0644 "$temporary_file"

if /usr/bin/test -f "$destination_file" && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$temporary_file" "$destination_file"; then
  exit 0
fi

/usr/bin/mv -f "$temporary_file" "$destination_file"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/sbin/restorecon -F "$destination_file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
/usr/bin/logger -t inventory-config-sync "updated $destination_file from node1"
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
sudo -n chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
sudo -n chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
